newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-FOUR PSG FANS JAILED FOR TWO MONTHS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FOUR PSG FANS JAILED FOR TWO MONTHS.

text.p: Four Paris St Germain supporters were jailed for two months and ordered to do 100 hours community service on Monday for acts of hooliganism at their team's home French first division clash with Marseille last week.
A Paris tribunal sentenced the four for damage to public property and attacking police officers at the game at Parc des Princes.
Two Marseille fans were placed under investigation after smuggling smoke bombs into the stadium, an offence punishable with a maximum three-year jail term.
